prior_importants.description: The new build script type-checks only non-test `src` files. The merge gate's only root type-check runs through `build`, so after this change no test file is type-checked by the gate.

findings.description: The code map's `depGraph` only makes edges from relative imports (`if (!imported.fileName.startsWith('.')) continue;`, L321). The tests this PR moves to test/unit/adapters now import through `@src/...`, and the src tests reach their mocks through `@test/helpers/...`, so none of those imports become edges. As a result, `pup map` and the launch knowledge slice no longer link src/adapters to its tests, and test/unit/adapters shows "depends on: nothing". Fix: resolve through `readPathAliases(repoPath)` + `resolveImport(file, imported.fileName, fileSet, aliases)`, which the dead-export pass already uses.

The decision-139 guard's `suiteFiles` scans `['src/**/*.ts', ...literalsIn(include)]`. The shared helpers moved from src/test/ to test/helpers/*.mock.ts, which neither glob matches. A future helper that reads an UNTESTED_PATH_GLOBS path, such as CLAUDE.md, would escape the guard and let the gate skip tests it needs. Nothing reads one today. Fix: add `'test/**/*.ts'` to the globs and update the L420/L450 docs.
